_how: Public videos on patystraffon.com/videos, from the Paty Straffon YouTube channel (UCFrUJPf12CYtRzeG0rYekVg). Each section shows its cards in rows of 3. Paste each video's ID (the part after watch?v=) into 'youtube'. A card with an empty ID is left off the page. 'thumb' is a file in site/images/videos/. Then run: python3 tools/build_pages.py
